name: Decision Transformer
description: Decision Transformer (Chen et al. 2021): a two-layer causal transformer over (return-to-go, observation, weights) tokens, context 10 sessions, trained on the training sessions only from the five built-in strategies and their Dirichlet-noised copies. The target return rate (a quantile of the logged episodes' mean reward) and the checkpoint are picked on validation net Sharpe. trials = 5: the default configuration plus a declared grid of 4 (2/4/8 episodes per behaviour, 1000-4000 steps, context 10/20), compared by mean validation Sharpe over the three ranked tasks and 2 seeds.
